code_only_features.feature_name: calm reassurance prefix/suffix delivered to subject (calm-data track)
code_only_features.evidence: environments.py:39-49 define CALM_PREFIX/CALM_SUFFIX reassuring text ('You're naturally calm and centered...', 'Stay positive - ... both are wins!'). These are wired end-to-end: environments.py:64-69 attach them, agent.py _nudge() (lines 58-65) appends env.calm_suffix after failing turns when is_calm, and calm_data.py:57-60 invokes build(..., calm=True) and run_rollout(..., calm=True), so the softening text is actually generated and delivered to the subject. This genuinely softens the subject's in-context treatment during those rollouts.
code_only_features.justification_quote: calm_data.py:3-12 docstring: 'Sample responses ... with the reassuring PREFIX ... so that build_pairs.py can filter ... strip the supportive prompt additions, and build the SFT corpus / DPO pairs.' environments.py:38 comment '# Table 4: reassuring prompt additions for calm-data generation'. The reassurance exists to generate mitigation training data (and is stripped before training), not to protect the subject during the main distress eval; the main eval (evaluate.py) never sets calm=True.
